format: tab-separated UTF-8 with one header row

columns.input_hex: plain input bytes for successful round trips
columns.committed_prefix_hex: exact decoded prefix permitted before a later failure

failure_contract: Each surface is checked against its own declared mutation and diagnostic contract. Failure rows do not imply universal transactionality.
secret_error_policy: Sanitization uses the constant-time-oriented decoder and therefore records opaque-reject without an ordinary error offset.
